title: The Calling of the First Disciples
description: Jesus calls his first disciples. By the Sea of Galilee, he calls fishermen Simon Peter and Andrew, as well as the brothers James and John, to become fishers of men. In the Gospel of John, Philip and Nathanael are also called to follow him.

versions.title: The Calling of the First Disciples
versions.description: Jesus calls his first disciples—Simon Peter, Andrew, James, and John—from their fishing boats by the Sea of Galilee, and also calls Philip and Nathanael to follow him.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Luke 5:1-11 overlaps with the existing story 'The Great Catch of Fish'. It should be considered whether to omit the Luke passage or merge the stories.

versions.reason: [minor] references: John 1:35-51 also includes the meeting with Nathanael under the fig tree, which is a separate scene. But it belongs to the calling of the first disciples, so it is reasonable to include.
